title: Choose the visual world for Engineer's Notebook
question: The roll assigned the Standards Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Standards Sheet
options.thesis: Every topic is a numbered clause: scope, symbols, formula, demo.
options.viewport: Clause margin, topic title, formula block before any prose, demo beside it.
options.risk: Can read as bureaucratic if the clause numbering is not kept light.

raised.raise: One active edge: a single yellow band marks the live clause, like the quarry's silver saw line.
Colour spent per unit: each engineering discipline gets its own signal colour, mechanics first.
State is a mark, not a hue: read, active and open clauses differ by shape and weight.

options.label: The Tabbed Handbook
options.thesis: A thumb-tabbed reference book where every table is one tap from the demo.
options.viewport: Edge tabs per section, a ruled formula table, the demo set as a figure.
options.risk: Familiar to engineers, and close to the dense textbook feel you want to avoid.

options.label: Miura Fold
options.thesis: Theory folds closed to a formula strip and unfolds into the full derivation.
options.viewport: Compact formula packet at the top, pull to open the derivation and demo.
options.case: Wins identification: a real mechanical structure. Loses clarity: folded headings slow lookup.
options.risk: Fold motion can get in the way of a quick formula lookup.

options.label: Side A / Side B
options.thesis: Side A is the formula you grab; side B is the demo you play.
options.viewport: Two hard halves on one sheet: formula listing and demo, with a flip between.
options.case: Holds clarity: formula versus demo maps onto the two sides. Loses identification: handwriting reads hobby, not engineering.
options.risk: Handwritten character may undercut trust in the formulae.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.case: Fuses poorly: weather imagery says nothing about mechanics.
options.kept: One silver active edge, now the yellow clause band.

options.label: Festival Hoarding
options.case: Fuses poorly: collage noise fights formula lookup.
options.kept: Colour spent per unit, now one signal colour per discipline.

options.label: Cracktro Queue
options.case: Fuses poorly: a game-scene costume on a page meant for reading.
options.kept: All text on one shared baseline unit.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.case: Fuses poorly: a film-editing tool laid over reading material.
options.kept: State told by mark, not hue.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean docs-style learning site, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar tree, article column, equation blocks, interactive figure inline.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other educational sites by design.
